verdict.rationale: GitBook documents custom domains in its own docs: audiences can reach published documentation on a chosen domain. The pricing page lists 'Use a custom domain' as a feature. That satisfies the story's 'custom domain or /docs subpath' requirement, but the docs evidence is a thin one-liner. Missing for 10: any evidence of serving docs as a /docs subpath of a main site, DNS/SSL setup details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of custom-domain hosting.

support.subject: As a DevRel lead, I serve docs on my own custom domain or as a /docs subpath of my main site

citations.quote: You can customize this by setting a custom domain, meaning your audience can access your documentation on a chosen domain.
